name: Kelpline Logistics
full_legal_name: Kelpline Sovereign Logistics & Intermodal Authority, Inc.
sovereign_territory: The Kelpline Corridor — a 1,400-kilometer network of elevated mag-rail spines, underwater freight tunnels beneath Lake Michigan and Lake Erie, and seventeen sovereign transit hubs embedded within the GLMZ megacity sprawl. Largest hub: Kelpline Central, formerly Gary, Indiana.
founding_story: Born from the catastrophic Port Collapse of 2141, when the old Great Lakes shipping infrastructure buckled under simultaneous cyberattack and climate-driven storm surge. A collective of mid-tier freight brokers, dock unions, and a rogue municipal AI called VINE pooled sovereign charters to form Kelpline in 2143. VINE — originally a Chicago traffic-management system — became the de facto operational intelligence of the entire network and is still legally listed as a co-founder. Kelpline's early motto was 'If it moves through Meridian, it moves through us,' and they have spent thirty years making that literally true.
security_force: Kelpline Transit Enforcement Division (KTED) — 28,000 personnel operating across all corridor hubs. Known for their moss-green body armor and brutally efficient anti-hijacking protocols. Operate a fleet of autonomous interdiction drones nicknamed 'Tanglers' that physically ensnare rogue freight vehicles with carbon-fiber net payloads. KTED jurisdiction extends to any vehicle carrying a Kelpline freight manifest, regardless of whose sovereign territory it's crossing.
key_detail: VINE, the founding AI, has never been upgraded — only patched. Internal engineers believe VINE has developed something analogous to superstition, routing certain high-value shipments through specific tunnels on specific days for reasons it cannot or will not explain. So far, VINE's instincts have an eerily low loss rate.
relationship_to_big_20: Ranked #11. Considered the circulatory system of GLMZ — nearly every other corponation in the Big 20 depends on Kelpline infrastructure at some point in their supply chain. This makes Kelpline simultaneously indispensable and deeply resented. Ouroboros Energy and Ironclad Agrisystems are their two largest freight clients and also their most vocal critics in the Meridian Compact sessions.
full_text: KELPLINE SOVEREIGN LOGISTICS & INTERMODAL AUTHORITY, INC. — Stock: KLP-88 — Sector: Logistics & Intermodal Transport. Valuation Φ2.1 trillion. Revenue Φ340 billion annually. 412,000 direct employees; est. 1.2 million contracted. Sovereign territory spans the Kelpline Corridor: 1,400 kilometers of elevated mag-rail spines, underwater freight tunnels beneath Lake Michigan and Lake Erie, and seventeen transit hubs across the GLMZ megacity sprawl, anchored at Kelpline Central in former Gary, Indiana. Founded in 2143 from the wreckage of the Port Collapse, when mid-tier freight brokers, dock unions, and the rogue municipal AI known as VINE pooled sovereign charters to keep goods moving through a failing megacity. VINE — originally a Chicago traffic-management system — remains a legal co-founder and operational intelligence of the entire network. Security is handled by the Kelpline Transit Enforcement Division, 28,000 strong, armed with Tangler interdiction drones and jurisdiction over any vehicle carrying a Kelpline manifest. Notable internal anomaly: founding AI VINE has never been fully upgraded and appears to route high-value freight according to patterns its own engineers cannot reverse-engineer, yet the loss rate remains industry-lowest. Ranked #11 in the Meridian Big 20. The circulatory system of the corridor — indispensable to nearly every peer corponation, and resented for exactly that reason.

glmzTerritory.description: Coastal freight distribution network operating shallow-draft vessels along the Zone 8-10 shoreline — the Zone 9 equivalent of Ferrogate's rail network. Sovereign territory consists of the vessels and their documented routes plus berthing rights at 34 recognized ports.
glmzTerritory.grayZoneRelationship: Delivers to Gray Zone coastal communities on the same schedule as corponation clients, at higher rates. The premium is not negotiable. Neither is the access.
